narrationScript: Now that we've covered how computers fundamentally operate, it's time to write our first program in C. C is a foundational language, powering everything from operating systems to embedded devices, giving you deep control over hardware. Don't let its 'low-level' reputation intimidate you; we'll start simple. Our very first program, a universal rite of passage, is the 'Hello, World!' program. This simple application demonstrates how to output text to your console. To make this happen, you'll write your human-readable C code in a text editor, and then use a **compiler**, like `clang` or `gcc`, to translate it into machine-executable instructions that your computer can understand and run.
